free_tier.stated: No free tier. Standard plan: USD 7 per TB per month of storage and USD 7 per TB of egress, with a USD 5 minimum monthly fee, after a free trial of 30 days with no credit card required.
free_tier.notes: no standing free allowance; the trial's 25GB of upload and download for 30 days is the only free volume

egress.terms: metered: Egress $7/TB on the Standard plan with no free allowance; the Standard egress price fell from $20/TB to $7/TB in the 2026 repricing

interface_detail: an S3-compatible gateway, and a native rclone backend
tooling: rclone, through its native storj backend or its s3 backend on the Storj S3-compatible gateway
chaining: S3-compatible, so any S3 client or rclone reaches it; every byte read out is billed at USD 7 per TB

identity_cost.detail: sign-up asks for an email address and a password, with no card; Pro account limits follow a payment method: a credit card (some debit cards; prepaid cards are not supported), Google Pay, Apple Pay, a bank account, or a deposit of USD 10 or more in USDC on Ethereum mainnet

reliability_note: designed for 11 nines (99.999999999%) durability via erasure coding; accounts with a USD 0 balance at the end of a billing cycle and no active storage are suspended and then deleted

evidence.proved: $7/TB storage AND $7/TB egress — the egress term alone ($7,168/TB-equivalent pattern) makes it the exact '$2 store with $10 egress' pathology inverted. $5/mo minimum. The egress was already
